arguments.sql_query:
WITH cv_conditions AS (
    SELECT co.person_id, COUNT(DISTINCT co.condition_concept_id) AS n_cv_conditions
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    INNER JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
        ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 134057 -- Disorder of cardiovascular system
      AND co.condition_concept_id <> 0
    GROUP BY co.person_id
), sex_denoms AS (
    SELECT p.gender_concept_id, c.concept_name AS sex, COUNT(*) AS total_n
    FROM omop.person p
    LEFT JOIN omop.concept c ON p.gender_concept_id = c.concept_id
    WHERE p.gender_concept_id IN (8532, 8507) -- FEMALE, MALE
    GROUP BY p.gender_concept_id, c.concept_name
)
SELECT
    d.sex,
    d.total_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(cv.n_cv_conditions, 0) >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cardiovascular_multimorbidity_n,
    CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(cv.n_cv_conditions, 0) >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / d.total_n AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS cardiovascular_multimorbidity_percent
FROM sex_denoms d
JOIN omop.person p ON p.gender_concept_id = d.gender_concept_id
LEFT JOIN cv_conditions cv ON cv.person_id = p.person_id
GROUP BY d.sex, d.total_n
ORDER BY d.sex;

content.text:
Using OMOP `person` and cardiovascular-condition descendants of SNOMED `134057` (“Disorder of cardiovascular system”), defining cardiovascular multimorbidity as ≥2 distinct cardiovascular condition concepts:

| Sex | Cohort size | Cardiovascular multimorbidity | Frequency |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Women | 3,807,338 | 297,999 | 7.83% |
| Men | 3,269,779 | 277,670 | 8.49% |

Men have a slightly higher frequency in this cohort: 8.49% vs 7.83% in women.
